title: Notice regarding Regular Division Bench of Hon'ble the Chief Justice Mrs. Justice Sunita Agarwal and Hon'ble Mr. Justice D. N. Ray on 29.09.2026.
text:
KEY LINES:
Read: Notice No. HCG-02/2026 Dated : 24.09.2026
Date: - 28/09/2026
preamble, It is hereby notified that on 29/09/2026;

FULL TEXT:
Read: Notice No. HCG-02/2026 Dated : 24.09.2026
The High Court of Gujarat
Ahmedabad
Date: - 28/09/2026
N O T I C E
HCG-01/2026
In partial modification of the Notice mentioned in the
preamble, It is hereby notified that on 29/09/2026;
1. Hon’ble the Chief Justice Mrs. Justice Sunita Agarwal and
Hon’ble Mr. Justice D. N. Ray would sit in Regular Division
Bench and take up the matters as per the Roster.
2. Hon’ble Mr. Justice Divyesh A. Joshi would Sit Single and
take up the matters as per the Roster.
By Order
Sd/-
Registrar [Judicial]
